name: Block .env File Read
description: Prevents Claude from reading .env files and other sensitive configuration files
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Block reading of sensitive config files
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
BLOCKED_PATTERNS=('.env' '.env.local' '.env.production' 'credentials.json' 'secrets.yaml' '.npmrc')
for pattern in "${BLOCKED_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
  if [[ "$(basename "$FILE")" == "$pattern" ]]; then
    echo "BLOCKED: Reading sensitive file '$pattern' is not allowed."
    exit 2
  fi
done
exit 0
